recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If Clinical Genomics wants MolecularDefinition to distinguish absolute strand from gene-relative orientation/sense, handle that through a new MolecularDefinition-specific tracker rather than this already-applied STU3 Sequence issue.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 Clinical Genomics request to split Sequence.referenceSeq.strand so absolute strand and gene-relative orientation were modeled separately as strand=watson|crick and orientation=sense|antisense.
initial_application: Historical commit ed2a92ec7970500700c90a1d576a6dd9963fcdc0 explicitly applied the split by adding Sequence.referenceSeq.orientation, changing Sequence.referenceSeq.strand to watson|crick, and updating examples and code lists. A git-svn build revision containing @14273 was unrelated Specimen build-number noise.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini lists Sequence under removed resources and has no active Sequence or MolecularSequence entry in [resources]. MolecularSequence carried the strand/orientation lineage after the 2018 rename, was later clarified by FHIR-37407 to use watson/crick, and was deleted from current source in 2025. Diagnostics narrative now points to MolecularDefinition as a replacing Additional Resource with a redesigned model, so applying the old Sequence.referenceSeq split there would be a new modeling decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the accepted FHIR-14273 change was applied to the historical target and the current build has no active Sequence.referenceSeq.strand location left to correct.
